children: Ciena Corporation

CIEN has put concrete targets behind the surge in AI-related networking demand. Fiscal third-quarter results showed faster growth, expanding cloud exposure and improving profitability as customers added optical capacity.

The next test is conversion. Backlog and multiyear customer commitments support visibility, but component availability and manufacturing capacity will help determine how much demand becomes revenue in fiscal 2027.
Ciena Corporation Price and Consensus
Ciena Corporation price-consensus-chart | Ciena Corporation Quote
Ciena's Q3 Results Set the 2027 Baseline

Fiscal third-quarter revenues increased 37% year over year to $1.67 billion. Adjusted earnings rose 215% to $2.11 per share, while adjusted operating margin reached 22.5%, up from 10.7% a year earlier.
Direct cloud-provider revenues represented 53% of quarterly sales and jumped 82% year over year. That mix underscores how hyperscaler spending is becoming more important to Ciena's growth trajectory.
CIEN's 2027 Guide Points to Another Step Up

Ciena expects fiscal 2027 revenues to grow at least 30%, following projected fiscal 2026 growth of 35% at the midpoint of its $6.42 billion revenue guidance. Management sees fiscal 2027 revenues reaching at least $8.3 billion to $8.4 billion.

Profitability is expected to scale with that growth. Ciena projects an adjusted gross margin of 45%-46% and an adjusted operating margin of 25%-27%, which would extend the operating leverage evident in the latest quarter.
Ciena's Backlog Extends Visibility Into 2029

Backlog reached $8.5 billion at the end of the fiscal third quarter and is expected to exceed $10 billion at fiscal year-end. Ciena has also secured increased customer commitments that extend through 2029.

The timing matters for the 2027 framework. Management said the vast majority of the expected year-end backlog carries customer-request dates in fiscal 2027 and covers most of the company's revenue guide for that year.
CIEN's Optical Products Are Broadening the AI Bet

RLS and Waveserver revenues each increased more than 55% year over year, while pluggables revenues more than doubled. WaveLogic 6 Nano 800ZR shipments more than doubled sequentially, and Ciena secured a second multi-rail win for high-density photonic infrastructure.
The broader market is showing similar AI networking investment.
Cisco Systems, Inc
. CSCO took $9.3 billion of AI infrastructure orders from hyperscalers in fiscal 2026 and expects $7.5 billion of related revenue in fiscal 2027.
Lumentum Holdings Inc
. LITE reported $1.01 billion of fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 revenues while highlighting advancing 1.6T cloud-module adoption as AI bandwidth requirements rise.
Ciena's Capacity Limits Could Shape the Ramp

Demand remains ahead of available supply. Management does not expect the constrained supply-demand balance to normalize before 2028, making component availability and manufacturing expansion central to the pace of fiscal 2027 growth.

Ciena has secured certain key components through 2029 and is investing upstream to increase capacity. Those agreements strengthen supply visibility but are expected to reduce fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 cash from operations as related investments are disbursed.
CIEN's Growth and Momentum Scores Back the Theme

The bottom line is that Ciena's 2027 guide gives the AI optical theme a measurable financial target. Backlog and product demand support the growth case, while supply constraints remain an important limit on how quickly the company can convert that demand.
